Method of Attack: Exploits CVE-2022-0543 Lua sandbox escape vulnerability for remote code execution
Creates P2P communication channel for auto-propagation
Downloads additional malicious binaries including scanning tools
Targets Internet-exposed Redis servers, especially in cloud container environments
Impacted Systems: Redis instances on Internet-exposed Windows and Linux systems
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2022-0543 vulnerability in Redis servers
Indicators of Compromise: Compromised Redis honeypots across multiple geographic regions
Presence of P2P nodes in HoneyCloud platform
